# Neural_Fields_World_Models

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A framework where neural fields (continuous implicit functions) are used to model the state and dynamics of an environment, enabling prediction and planning. Provides a differentiable, continuous representation of world state that can be embedded in neuromorphic hardware for real-time predictive processing.
